CHAP. XIX.
Lot receiuing Angelt in hit bouſe ie abuſed by the Sadomites. 12. He with hie
wife (20. who for loking back is turned into a ſtatua of ſatt) and hit two
daughters, are deliuer ed. 24. Sodome and Gomorre art burned. 31. Lot licth
vnwitting with both hit daughters, & begat of them Moab aud Ammon, of
whom camt the Moabites and Ammonites.
NB the two (a) Angels came to Sodome at euen, and
Lot ſitting in the gates ot the citie. Who when he had
ſeen them, roſe vp & went to meet then: and adored
proſtrate vnto the ground, 2. and ſaid : I beſeech you,
my Lords , turne into the houſe of vour ſeruant, and
lodge there: waſh your teet, and in the morning you
ſhal goe torth on your way. Who ſaid : No, but we wil abide in the

ſtreet. 3. He compelled them eatneſtly to turne in vnto him: and when
they were entred into his houſe, he made them a banquet, and baked
vnleauened bread, and they did eate. 4. And before they went to bed,
the men of the citie beſet the houſe trom yong to old, al the people
together. 5. And they called Lot, and ſaid to him : Where are the men
that came in to thee at night: bring the forth hither that we may know
them, 6. Lot going torth to them , and ſhutting the dore atter him, ſaid:
7. Doe not ſo, Ibeſeech you, my brethren, doe not commit this euil.
B. I haue two daughters, which as vet haue not Ænowen man: I wil
bring them torth toyou , and abuſe you them as it ſhal pleaſe you, ſo
that vou doe no euil to theſe tnen becauſe they are entted vnder the
ſhadow of tny toote. 9. But they ſaid : Get thee backe thither. And
againe : Thou cameſt in, ſaid they , as a ſttanger, what to be a Iudge?
Thy ſelfe ther fore we wil atflict more then theſe. And they did violece
to Lot exceedingly: and it was euen now at the point that they would
break the dores. 10. And behold the men put torth thrir hand, end drew
in Lot vnto them, and ſhut the dore: 11. and them that were without
they ſtruck with blindnes trom the leaſt to the greateit, ſo that they
could not find the dore. 12. Aud they ſaid to Lot: Haſt thou here anie
of thine? ſonne in law, or ſonnes, or daughterts, al that art thine
bring them out of this citie: 13. for we wil deſttoy this place, for that
(b) their cry is waxen loud betore our Lord, who hath Ient vs to de-
ſtroy them. 14. Therfore Lot went forth, and ſpake to his ſonnes in
law that were to take his daughters, and ſaid : Ariſe, get vou torth out
of this place, becauſe our Lord wil deſtrov this citie. And he ſermed
vnto them to ſpeake as it were in ieſt. 15. And when it was morning,
